visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair, wearing black-rimmed glasses and a grey baseball cap, stands in a brightly lit airport terminal. She wears a black t-shirt. She looks towards the camera with a confused expression, her mouth slightly open. The background features metallic architectural beams and airport signage. (2) The woman is now seated, speaking directly to the camera in a selfie style. She looks around the terminal as she speaks, her expressions fluctuating between seriousness and frustration. Glass elevators and information displays are visible in the background, illuminated by natural light through large windows. (3) She continues her explanation, gesturing with her hands to emphasize her points. Her gaze shifts occasionally from the lens to the surrounding terminal. The lighting remains bright and consistent. Several text overlays appear on the screen in Traditional Chinese to supplement her narrative. (4) In the final moments, the woman brings her right hand to her neck in a playful choking gesture, looking upwards with a self-deprecating smirk. The camera remains steady in a medium close-up, capturing her final reaction to the described ordeal before the video ends.
